overview: Google's Gemini 4 Argon dominated the day. Google says the model tops Text Arena and the Vals Index, offers a 1M-token output limit, and is going first to the US government and vetted cyber defenders, with wider access later. Also notable: Musk's comments on Starship Flight 14, xAI's Grok Bot and Grokipedia updates, the White House Super Intelligence Accord, and better-than-expected US economic data. Kalshi's CBS midterms deal also landed.

top_items.title: GoogleAI - Gemini 4 Argon launches with a 1M-token output limit, going first to trusted cyber defenders in the Fairwind Program
sundarpichai - Pichai says Argon has frontier safeguards and is with the US government now, promising rapid iteration and broader release
elonmusk - Musk, after Starship reached orbit for the first time, says it will put much larger telescopes in orbit and giant ones on the Moon
elonmusk - Grok Bot can now hand coding tasks to Cursor cloud agents and manage GitHub PRs; Grokipedia v0.3 also released
DavidSacks - Sacks: Q2 GDP revised up to 2.2% from 1.5%, core PCE 3.0% vs 3.3% expected, ADP jobs +90k vs ~68k
chamath - Shared Jensen Huang's post that industry leaders signed the White House Accord on Super Intelligence at the White House
mansourtarek_ - Kalshi partners with CBS News to put prediction-market forecasts for key races and Congress into midterm coverage
